title: Engine, Ignition
overview: When the global network is disrupted, Haruka must use a power inherited from her father to protect her family.

title: Vertex
overview: Just after Akira's hidden power reveals itself, two unfamiliar women appear before him.

title: Ardent Feelings
overview: Haruka and Akira depart for Hokkaido with Eleanor and Lala to find the fifth Vertex.

title: Brother and Sister
overview: On a deserted island, Lala devises a plan to use Akira as bait to lure EDVA to them.

title: That's the Answer
overview: As Lala works through the night alone to analyze the Battlenoid, the other four decide to make coffee for her.

title: It's No Mistake
overview: The five Vertex visit a populated island to buy food, but its residents have evacuated due to a typhoon.

title: Today Is the Day
overview: Lala comes up with a way to defeat EDVA, but putting the plan into action isn't so easy.

title: Summer Break for the Five
overview: With EDVA out of the picture, the VERTEX are free to part ways... but Yoko has other ideas.
